preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The number of different types of ingredients N is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The quantity of each ingredient A_i is between 1 and 10^4, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is either a non-negative integer or -1, indicating the maximum number of times Rupsa needs to pick items or that it's impossible.
